skins.name: Casual
skins.description: Rainproof, wear-resistant, close-fitting yet breathing, the first choice for fashionable youth. Coloring of the lining and some accessories can be changed at the client's request, letting their no-imitation individuality pop.

skins.name: Frosted Breath
skins.description: Layered insulating design, free to be mixed and matched to individual taste. Catered to the client's personal needs, this fit has been altered by hand, adjusting the left sleeve's opening and adding an arm guard.

skins.name: Modeling Night
skins.description: Tailored Kazimierzian apparel, slim-fit, highly accessorized, accompanied by a cloak in a complementary shade, sure to draw the eyes of every onlooker.

skins.name: Soft Wool
skins.description: Cozy and warm standard line winter garments. With personalized coordination, you can attain your perfect balance of fashion and everyday use.
